title: Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting
function: Ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining for net-shape tolerance
TIG welding all positions for net-shape tolerance
DPI dye penetrant inspect for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for ultrahigh purity hydrogen application
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure — critical for ultrahigh purity hydrogen performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting is suitable for ultrahigh purity hydrogen in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting?
faq.a: Each Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for ultrahigh purity hydrogen.
